<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def cup_state():
    b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    reg=[(i,j) for i in range(19,36) for j in range(14,52) if b[i][j] in 'pg' and not (i>=34 and 27<=j<=36)]
    if not reg: return 'none'
    r0=min(i for i,j in reg); r1=max(i for i,j in reg); c0=min(j for i,j in reg); c1=max(j for i,j in reg)
    return f'rows{r0}-{r1} cols{c0}-{c1} p={sum(1 for i,j in reg if b[i][j]=="p")}'
print('now(left-tilt):', cup_state())
action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT:', cup_state())
action(['UP'])
print('after UP:', cup_state())
action(['DOWN'])
print('after DOWN:', cup_state())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
